text: In March 2006, the children's book And Tango Makes Three by Justin Richardson and Peter Parnell was moved from the children's section of two Rolling Hills Consolidated Library branches, in Savannah and St. Joseph in northwest Missouri, after parents complained that it had homosexual undertones. In July 2014 the National Library Board in Singapore removed the book from its children's section, and it was later moved to the adult section instead of being removed. In June 2015 it was one of 49 titles withdrawn from Venice municipal nursery and pre-schools by Mayor Brugnaro.
meta_description: And Tango Makes Three by Richardson and Parnell: moved from children's sections in 2006 in Missouri, removed in Singapore in 2014, withdrawn in Venice in 2015.
